title: Introduce per-tenant KMS binding templates and audit-fanout coordinator for region-aware compliance
author: Maya Kline
description: Motivation: customers with strict data residency and audit requirements need deterministic KMS selection and auditable fanout of events across region boundaries. This PR introduces two coordinated pieces: 1) a per-tenant KMS binding template CRD and generator that produces tenant-scoped KMS policy artifacts (binding templates that can be consumed by the Private installer and by Dedicated provisioners) and 2) an audit-fanout-coordinator service that deduplicates, shards, and signs audit events for cross-region forwarding while preserving tenant region-pinning. The change is backward-compatible with current operator RBAC v1 flows and is behind the feature flag "tenant-kms-template-rollout". Changes include an RBAC v2 policy generator that emits operator-scope assertions with a region_pin claim when a tenant has region constraints. The generator also attaches minimal provenance metadata so we can later prove KMS origin in incident investigations. Rollout plan: (a) deploy generator in a canary namespace, (b) enable feature flag for 5 pilot tenants, (c) observe metrics and audit delivery latencies for two weeks, (d) flip feature flag for general availability. Migration: existing tenants without region pins continue to use the runtime default and are unaffected. Security review summary: principle of least privilege applied to generated bindings; templates only reference tenant-scoped service accounts and avoid global operator roles; KMS keys are referenced by ARN/URI and templated region tags are validated against the tenant-residency registry during generation. Testing: unit tests for template rendering (templates_test.go), integration harness for the installer with a mock KMS provider (integration/tenant_kms_harness), e2e for audit fanout using localstack S3 and an emulated event bus (e2e/audit_fanout_spec). Monitoring: new metrics: kms_binding_generation_errors, audit_fanout_latency_p50/p95/p99, audit_dedup_rate; dashboards added to the Console under Compliance -> Audit Fanout. Known limitations: multi-provider KMS fallback is not automatic in this PR (future work), tenant scoped key rotation hooks are stubbed; documented in the design note. Related work: builds on ENG-4820 (region registry), references SEC-54 for RBAC v2 schema stabilization. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked - [x] unit tests - [x] integration tests - [x] e2e smoke - [x] SLO/metric instrumentation - [x] security review sign-off. Release notes: Adds an opt-in per-tenant KMS binding template generator and an audit fanout coordinator service to enable region-aware KMS enforcement and auditable cross-region forwarding. Admins must enable the feature flag and provide tenant residency metadata to activate.
